summary: Nicholas County tower: towerman began duty early in March 1946 because of dry weather; registered 2017 as US 1680; listed gone, no build or removal date found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the association; no removal date or site description in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, description or removal date found in the register or the Eastern list (one article, 1946). The 1929 date is only the caption of a Facebook photo post; the post body was not readable, and the caption is not a build date. Status comes from the FFLA county list. The 1946 article names the newspaper as Beckley Post-Herald. Next step if someone has time: Nicholas County newspapers or the state forestry annual reports for construction and removal dates. No site description is available, so the story says so. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story now says 'about two weeks early' because the item gives two weeks and fourteen days, and March 8 to March 20 is 12 days. The 'unusually dry and windy' wording was paraphrased.
